subject: Request: one-off pilot credits + POC extension for Arcadia Labs
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@arcadialabs.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwoodinference.com>, Samir Patel <samir.p@arcadialabs.com>
Cc: procurement@arcadialabs.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: POC extension + temporary credits

Hi Priyom,

Quick note from our side — we ran into an unexpected blocker with a third-party data connector. Engineering estimates a 4–6 week delay before the integration is stable enough to run the POC at scale. That puts us past your standard 30-day PLG sandbox window.

Given the timeline and the fact the team is blocked on realistic load testing, can Redwood: 1) extend the POC window by 60 days, and 2) provide a one-time credit to cover the initial synthetic load tests (~200k token equivalent) so we can validate latency/cost profiles once integration is done?

We're close on SSO and the dataflow agreement; procurement can issue a PO if we have written approval on this one-off concession. Attaching our updated POC scope and proposed timeline for visibility.

Thanks — Elena

--
Elena Morales
VP Engineering, Arcadia Labs
elena@arcadialabs.com
[Attachment: POC-scope.pdf (PDF)]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: POC extension + temporary credits — need exec signoff

Team — forwarding Arcadia's ask. Key points:
- 60-day extension request (they want 60, but standard PLG cap is 30)
- One-time credit request for ~200k tokens to do load tests once their connector is fixed
- They will provide PO once we have written exec approval

My read: large strategic, strong co-sell potential, enterprise procurement already engaged, they can convert to Dedicated within a quarter if latency/costs look good. Recommendation: consider a one-off token credit (100–200k) + extension tied to a short SOW / PO signature by a firm date.

Can we get a quick yes/no from deal desk / finance on whether we can approve this as a one-time exception and what conditions to attach? I can offer staging SRE hours if needed.

Thanks — Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
pri yom.d@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (DOCX)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: POC extension + temporary credits — recommended guardrails

Jonas/Marissa —

Quick proposal from deal desk: approve a one-time pilot concession but with strict conditions to avoid precedent creep. Suggested terms: 
- Credit: 200,000 token-equivalent credit (one-time).
- Extension: 45 days (not 60) from the current sandbox end date.
- Conditions: PO or signed SOW within 21 days of approval; credit applied only after PO is received; enable logging & cost alerts; require milestone sign-off (basic perf tests) before any additional concessions.

Rationale: keeps customer momentum, ties concession to procurement paperwork, and limits exposure. If finance prefers smaller token amount we can reduce to 125k. Also recommend offering 4 hours of SRE support to speed integration.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Deal Desk | Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.d@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: POC extension + temporary credits — approval

All,

Approve the concession with the following binding conditions (I will sign off formally):
1) One-time credit: 200,000 token-equivalent (to be tracked as a promotional credit).
2) Extension: 45 days beyond the current sandbox expiry (we will not set a rolling 60-day PLG exception).
3) Procurement requirement: Arcadia must submit a PO or a signed SOW by 2026-07-20 to activate the extension and credit. Credit will only be applied after we receive PO.
4) Controls: enable per-route logging and cost alerts; product to flag heavy usage to the deal desk.

This is a one-off executive exception tied to DEAL-9438; do not standardize. Priyom — coordinate contract/PO language with Marissa. Karthik — please update HubSpot with the concession and add the deal note and approval.

Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Chief Financial Officer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwoodinference.com

Elena / Samir — great news: our CFO has approved a one-time, non-recurring concession for Arcadia. Summary of what we can do and what we need from you: 

What Redwood will provide:
- One-time credit = 200,000 token-equivalent promotional credit applied to your account once we receive the PO/SOW.
- Sandbox extension = 45 days from your current sandbox expiry.
- 4 hours of SRE onboarding support to accelerate testing.

Conditions (required to activate):
1) Procurement: PO or signed SOW by 2026-07-20.
2) Enable logging & cost alerts in the sandbox environment (we will send a checklist).
3) Milestone: basic perf test sign-off after integration completion (we'll provide success criteria).

Attachments: updated SOW draft and the POC scope you sent are attached. HubSpot: DEAL-9438; DocuSign link for SOW will be sent after you confirm PO timeline.

Please reply with the expected PO date and any questions. We'll hold the extension request for activation once procurement confirms.
